ozkar waters.name: Ozkar Waters
ozkar waters.first_appearance: King in Black: Planet of the Symbiotes Vol 1 3
ozkar waters.origin: Ozkar Waters and his son Bren moved from Washington, D.C. to Staten Island, obtaining a job at Alchemax as a security guard in the hopes of improving life for himself and his son. When Alchemax launched its Guardsmen to hunt down extraterrestrial threats, Ozkar received a promotion to their ranks and was dispatched to retrieve a Brood/Human hybrid created by Alchemax's unethical experiments. Unbeknownst to Ozkar, Bren had become the host of the Toxin symbiote, and attempted to subdue the Brood/Human hybrid before learning its origin story. Assuming Toxin to be evil, Ozkar attacked and tried to kill him, but Toxin escaped and Ozkar helped recapture the Brood/Human hybrid - arriving home shortly after his son. A few months later, Ozkar arrested Andi Benton for having been bonded to the Scream symbiote, briefly arguing with her over the ethics of his work as a Guardsman. Some time later, Ozkar welcomed Buck Cashman from the Friends of Humanity into Alchemax headquarters, but when he was revealed to be the host of the Phage symbiote he engaged him in combat and was badly wounded in the ensuing fight. While being loaded into an ambulance, Ozkar was surprised to see Bren had arrived on the scene and lied to his son when asked if he was one of Alchemax's Guardsmen.

fields.history: Ozkar Waters and his son Bren moved from Washington, D.C. to Staten Island, obtaining a job at Alchemax as a security guard in the hopes of improving life for himself and his son. When Alchemax launched its Guardsmen to hunt down extraterrestrial threats, Ozkar received a promotion to their ranks and was dispatched to retrieve a Brood/Human hybrid created by Alchemax's unethical experiments. Unbeknownst to Ozkar, Bren had become the host of the Toxin symbiote, and attempted to subdue the Brood/Human hybrid before learning its origin story. Assuming Toxin to be evil, Ozkar attacked and tried to kill him, but Toxin escaped and Ozkar helped recapture the Brood/Human hybrid - arriving home shortly after his son. A few months later, Ozkar arrested Andi Benton for having been bonded to the Scream symbiote, briefly arguing with her over the ethics of his work as a Guardsman. Some time later, Ozkar welcomed Buck Cashman from the Friends of Humanity into Alchemax headquarters, but when he was revealed to be the host of the Phage symbiote he engaged him in combat and was badly wounded in the ensuing fight. While being loaded into an ambulance, Ozkar was surprised to see Bren had arrived on the scene and lied to his son when asked if he was one of Alchemax's Guardsmen.

ozymandias.name: Ozymandias
ozymandias.species: Human Mutate (Altered by En Sabah Nur)
ozymandias.origin: ===Early Life=== Ozymandias was a son of Ancient Egypt's pharaoh Amenhotep. His father was deposed by mysterious Rama-Tut, while Ozymandias was forced to serve him as general. Ozymandias had always wanted to take the throne that he believed to be rightfully his, but had no way to defeat Rama-Tut. Decades later Rama-Tut had sent him to the camp of the Sandstormers to capture man named En Sabah Nur. Rama-Tut, being actually a time-traveller from the 30th century, knew what one day Nur would become a powerful mutant Apocalypse, so he wanted to make him his heir and control his future. Ozymandias had slaughtered the Sandstormers, but failed to capture Nur. Later on Nur came to the capital anyway and opposed Rama-Tut. In the ensuing battle, Ozymandias used the opportunity to enter the Sphinx, which was actually Rama-Tut's time traveling ship. Ozymandias wanted to obtain the knowledge and weapons inside, but was intercepted by En Sabah Nur who now fully awakened his mutants powers. Nur hated Ozymandias for killing his family, so he used his powers to transform Ozymandias's body into living stone, and then also used the Eye of Ages to show him all history of humanity in a matter of second. All of it broke Ozymandias's mind, he became Apocalypse's slave and dutifully served him for thousands of years, too afraid to ever oppose him again. He depicted the visions he saw in the Eye of Ages as sculptures, providing information about the future to Apocalypse. ===Final Horsemens=== In 281 Ozymandias followed Apocalypse to Rome, where they recruited young mutant Decimus Furius. In 325 they then visited Persia to recruit Sanjar Javeed. In 1833 they recruited Ichisumi and in 1863 — Jeb Lee. All four were placed into stasis right after recruitment, to serve as Apocalypse's final horsemen. ===19th Century=== Ozymandias was present when the Clan Akkaba resurrected Apocalypse to battle Dracula and his Vampire horde. It was shown that he had been influencing members of the Clan for his own ends for centuries. ===Present Days=== During her youth, Ororo Munroe, who would become the X-Men member Storm in adulthood, was hired to steal Ozymandias's magical gemstone,the Opal of Ozymandias. When he recognized Ororo from his visions, he let her go with the Opal, knowing that Storm would eventually be instrumental in Apocalypse's plans for the powerful mutants known as the Twelve. Ozymandias was later discovered by the X-Men as they searched for Wolverine. As he battled the X-Men, he warned them of both Nur's return and the coming of Onslaught. In Morocco, Ozymandias carved a picture in the wall of tomb of Apocalypse showing Cyclops handing over Cable to the Askani and Archangel taking to the air. Ozymandias finished his drawing and wondered if the "dream" was being extinguished. Apocalypse stepped up behind him and told him, "It is done." Apocalypse told him that humanity had reached its darkest hour and that his greatest enemy was nearing death. and that this is the best time to prepare for the dawn of his empire. ... ... While Caliban slept peacefully in his bed while surrounded by his toys and dolls. Ozymandias stood above him and told him that this will be Caliban's last night to sleep in the mansion before the storm comes. He told the the sleeping Caliban that he envies the friends that freed Caliban from Apocalypse's hold over him. He warns that Apocalypse does not give up his hold that easily, however and that when Caliban's pain is too much, he will return to Apocalypse. Caliban had been hiding out in the tunnels since the Zero Tolerance soldiers stormed the mansion. Caliban told him someone told him that he is not supposed to go. Then Ozymandias revealed himself as the one controlling Caliban. He puts Cable to sleep and told him that when he wakes he will think that Caliban is with a friend and is safe. Caliban then follows Ozymandias out of the tunnels to go back to Apocalypse. ... Ozymandias was present when Cyclops was merged with Apocalypse. ===Decimation=== He was seen after Decimation working alongside Apocalypse again. This time however, he wanted to betray him, and be the master. When Doctor Foster was fighting Gazer, and was about to kill him, Ozymandias ran an axe through the Doctor, to force Gazer onto his side. Later, when he called for recollection, Gazer was brainwashed by Apocalypse and defied him. With the help of the X-Men, Apocalypse was defeated, and Ozymandias killed Gazer for defying him. ... ... ozzy ostrich.name: Ozzy Ostrich
ozzy ostrich.first_appearance: Peter Porker, The Spectacular Spider-Ham Vol 1 14
ozzy ostrich.origin: Ozzy Ostrich a musician who played a concert in which Spider-Ham was taking pictures for the Daily Beagle. Peter hated the music and clogged his ears with cotton wool so he couldn't hear it. After the show, his Spider-Sense went off and he changed into costume and began to explore. Hearing what sounded like a robbery he busted through a door and began attacking Ozzy in the process, he destroyed Ozzy's guitar. It turned out Ozzy and his manager were just exchanging baking recipes and Peter handed over the money to Ozzy to pay for a new guitar. He went to a pawn shop and tested out a new guitar, which instantly hypnotized Ozzy to do the Pawn Brokers bidding. He returned to perform a show and hypnotized the entire audience, except Peter due to his ear-plugs, into committing robberies of every store in the city to bring to the Pawn Broker. Peter followed Ozzy back to the Pawn broker and tricked him into smashing his guitar over the Pawn Broker's head freeing him and everyone else from the hypnotic spell. Ozzy thanked Peter for rescuing him.

p d q werner.name: P.D.Q. Werner
p d q werner.first_appearance: Nick Fury, Agent of SHIELD Vol 1 2
p d q werner.origin: P.D.Q. Werner was a Hollywood film director. He had picked Centurius's island Valhalla as a filming location when Nick Fury and Jimmy Woo crash-landed on the island and defeated Centurius. Werner then travelled to San Francisco to film a monster movie starring Brad Carter; he also filmed real attacks of monsters to use them in the movie. Werner's team then met monster-fighter Ulysses Bloodstone, whom Werner tried to hire as an actor, but instead Bloodstone recruited Carter as an aide in his travels.

p j james.name: P.J. James
p j james.origin: Nothing is known of P.J. James' early life, but at some point he used his apparently-superhuman musical talent to become a world-renowned musician.; One day he played for free at a Manhattan nightclub, one of the very few occasions where he allowed himself to be seen by the public without the purchase of an expensive ticket. He was an old friend of Dazzler, and introduced her and Rogue, who were patronizing the club, to his friend, the Japanese musician Makoto Suzuki. Their performance was interrupted by a group of thugs who sought to hold P.J. for ransom. To stop them, Rogue kissed P.J. to take on his musical talent, then expertly played a keyboard, the sound of which Dazzler transformed into beams of light, defeating the thugs.

p j organ.name: P.J. Organ
p j organ.origin: P.J. Organ was a bank owner that operated in the town of Jimtown during the 1940s. An idle millionaire, he took up organized crime as a hobby much like his fellows would take up golf. To this end, he organized a gang led by Muscles Moe into robbing one of his own bank's armored cars. He equipped the mob with sleeping gas and special gas masks and body suits to render them invulnerable to the gas. The crime attracted the attention of Detective Clancey Mullaney who, with the aid of Free Press reporters Tom Powers and Kenny Roberts, connected a pair of discarded gloves and a gas mask to Muscles Moe. When Mullaney and the two members of the press confronted Muscles, P.J. Organ revealed his involvement in the crimes. During the ensuing fight, Organ was punched out by Powers and the rest of his gang was defeated. With the loot uncovered, P.J. and his gang were turned over to the authorities.

p t oakley.name: P.T. Oakley
p t oakley.origin: P.T. Oakley was one of a trio of washed-up, drunken depraved Hollywood actors that Dominic Fortune was hired to bodyguard and babysit. He traveled with Fortune from Los Angeles to New York City, engaging in all kinds of delinquent behavior along the way until Fortune had a police officer friend of his arrest the men in order to ensure that they wouldn't miss their ride. From there they took a zeppelin to Berlin in order to take in the 1936 Summer Olympics. While in Berlin, all three men had bearer's bonds worth millions of dollars put into their suitcases by Malcolm Upshaw in order to smuggle them back into the United States as part of his plot to overthrow the government. When confronted by Fortune, the men stated that they had no idea that the bonds had been placed there. Believing them, Fortune took Oakley and the others back to New York City where he dumped them at the most notorious cathouse in the city while he tried to foil Upshaw's scheme. Once Upshaw had been defeated, the three actors were seen partying with Fortune back in Los Angeles. Their subsequent activities have not been revealed.

pablo mendez.name: Pablo Mendez
pablo mendez.origin: Pablo was the nephew of Ernesto Mendez, an inventor who invented an engine valve that would save fuel and reduce pollution. Pablo advised his uncle to sell the valve design to Mr. Markham of the Markham Machine Company who would have paid a fortune, but his uncle replied piquedly that his invention was for the whole world. Markham later had Ernesto beaten to death and kidnapped Pablo to appropriate the find. On his deathbed, Ernesto begged Eddie Brock to save his nephew Pablo. When Eddie went to Markham's factory to rescue Pablo, he didn't find him prisoner but free and armed thinking that Pablo had broken free, but suddenly Pablo shot Venom and yelling at Markham's men that Venom was there. Venom initially felt betrayed, but after successfully escaping the trap of molten metal, he was able to pull Pablo aside. Pablo told him that he knew his uncle was angry with him for giving Markham the blueprint of his invention but that he would calm down once he showed him the money Markham had given him. At that point Venom told Pablo that his uncle had been killed by Markham's men on his orders, than Pablo fell into deep despair blaming his uncle's death on himself.

pablo morales.name: Pablo Morales
pablo morales.origin: Psi was a member of the Brooklyn Avengers, who, like the other residents of Mr. Furlong's building, gained mild powers after being exposed to a radioactive pesticide sprayed on the building by Furlong. They fought crime alongside Spider-Man, who was just starting his superhero career, but Spider-Man quickly left the group, considering them disorganized and a danger to themselves. Years later, a couple of Brooklyn Avengers members died, and, although his brother believed the first two victims had died due to their advanced age, Psi was convinced that someone had caused their deaths, only to become a victim of Red Hook himself. Red Hook, in reality, was Mr. Furlong disguised as an old enemy of the Brooklyn Avengers, who wanted to get rid of the residents and then sell the building.

pacifier robot.name: Pacifier Robot
pacifier robot.origin: The Pacifier Robot was created by Doctor Doom as a killing machine lacking any personality that could be controlled from a distance. It was never activated and is probably still in Doctor Doom's Castle. thumb|left|Pacifier When Doom tried to convince the Silver Surfer of his good intentions, he showed him his workshop with several of his developments, including the Pacifier. Doom claimed that the Pacifier was designed to help people who were in danger due to tyranny or injustice, and that weapons such as it were needed to protect himself and his country from the so-called enemies of freedom.

packrat pete.name: Packrat Pete
packrat pete.origin: Packrat was a gold prospector who lived in Leadville, Texas during the days of the American Frontier. One for tall tales, and knowing local happenings, he was often a source of information to the western hero known as the Black Rider, while at the same time giving the Rider's alter ego -- Doctor Matthew Masters -- his opinions on romance and women, usually being of the opinion that women were never worth the trouble. Packrat helped inform Matthew Masters about the arrival of railroad politico Mr. Cantrell, who the Black Rider exposed as inciting violence between the people of Leadville and a local Native American tribe to buy ranch land cheaply. It was Packrat who suggested and convinced the Black Rider to perform at the local rodeo shortly thereafter. Packrat also had passing knowledge of the influx of Mexican immigrants who were entering the United States illegally, another criminal operation shut down by the Black Rider. Despite Packrat's issues with women, he still managed to get one to go with him to the local dance. This is also amazing in spite of the fact that Packrat's lack of sanitary habits, as Matthew Masters found out when Pete came complaining about corns on his feet, and Masters found nothing but caked on dirt. Packrat was shocked when the Black Rider was accused of murdering Matthew Masters, however the Black Rider ultimately cleared his name. Packrat also informed Masters of local troubles with a nearby Native American tribe, another local event quelled by the Black Rider. Packrat was last seen showing the property that was recently inherited by Lenore Van Ryn to the Black Rider. Soon after the Black Rider left Leadville to defend the west severing his ties with his hometown, Packrat's subsequent fate is unknown.

paddy fitzgerald.name: Paddy Fitzgerald
paddy fitzgerald.origin: Paddy Fitzgerald's father, Dennis was a fanatically militant Irish nationalist, when his daughter Molly was three years old, her father took her and Paddy to the North Ireland mountainsides and asked the heavens to grant his son the power to strike down its enemies. Although nothing seemed to have happened, Molly learned during her first year at University that she was the one who was blessed and used her "good luck powers" to become Ireland's super heroine, Shamrock. Meanwhile Paddy joined the IRA where he died in a terrorist bomb blast.

pagon.name: Pagon
pagon.species: Skrull having undergone the Infiltration Ritual (Super-Skrull)
pagon.origin: Pagon was a male Skrull warrior and the lover of Queen Veranke. Pagon succeeded where Siri and two others failed and successfully replaced Elektra. Afterwards, Pagon took over the Hand, severing its ties with Hydra and followed Veranke's plan to allow the Avengers to kill him. When the ninja warrior Echo infiltrated The Hand at the request of Daredevil and Captain America, Pagon posing as Elektra captured her. She then orchestrated the attempted brainwashing of the deaf woman to make her a loyal member of The Hand. The New Avengers went to Japan to rescue Echo where they fought The Hand in a grand battle ending in the near-fatal stabbing of Doctor Strange by the woman they believed was Elektra. Echo snapped out of her half-brainwashed state and stabbed Pagon through his midsection with a katana, killing him. The Avengers were stunned when Elektra's form shifted into that of a Skrull. His disguise had fooled even Wolverine’s enhanced senses. Upon leaving Japan, the Avengers debated what to do about the Skrull body. Spider-Woman claimed the best thing would be to take it to Tony Stark, who would then know the best thing to do. Most of the others disagreed. The debate was cut short when the jet was sent down by Spider-Woman exiting the jet, causing it to crash. She then returned to the crash site and took the former Elektra’s body and brought it to the Avengers Tower where Tony Stark was stationed. left|thumb|Pagon's body The body was moved to a secret location, it’s exact nature not being disclosed to anyone more than it had been already. It was a cause of worry for Stark, as he believed it the harbinger of worse to come. If The Hand could be infiltrated so easily, any organisation could be, he reasoned and didn’t want any other possible Skrulls to know they had been found out yet. Stark eventually trusted the information to his two closest compatriots, Reed Richards and Henry Pym, who he was unaware was, in fact, the Skrull agent Criti Noll. They were taken to the lab which housed the Skrull corpse and both seemed concerned by the information that Elektra was a Skrull, Pym even asking "For how long?". Stark was then called away, leaving Richards and Pym to further examine the body.

They were taken to the lab which housed the Skrull corpse and both seemed concerned by the information that Elektra was a Skrull, Pym even asking "For how long?". Stark was then called away, leaving Richards and Pym to further examine the body.

paibok.name: Paibok
paibok.origin: ===Origins=== Paibok was born on the planet Tarnax IV, in the Tarnax System in the Andromeda Galaxy and which was part of the Skrull Empire, but has since been destroyed. Paibok was trained at the Skrull military academy, and became a Skrull espionage agent, and a captain in the Skrull armed forces. Paibok was behind the plot to replace Alicia Masters with Lyja. thumb|left|100px ===Fearsome Foursome=== When Johnny Storm went to trial for setting fire to Empire State University, he was attacked in the courtroom by Paibok and Devos. Simultaneously, Klaw attempted to have his revenge upon the Fantastic Four by manipulating Huntara into joining them. Working together they attacked the FF as the Fearsome Foursome. However the Fantastic Four were Spider-Man, Sandman, Silver Sable and Daredevil. They were winning until the Avengers arrived, so they decided to retreat through a portal opened by Huntara. Daredevil attempted to pursue, but the dimension in which he found himself confused his senses, and he had to be pulled out by Spider-Man. On Paibok's starship they planned to destroy the FF at Four Freedoms Plaza, where they lay in wait for the Fantastic Four's return. When the heroes returned, Huntara launched into battle with Psi-Lord, leading the two of them away from the others. The remaining members of the Fantastic Four were taken out by knock-out gas delivered by Devos and Paibok. The two allies then teleported their captives to Paibok's ship, so that they could turn them over to the Skrull Empire. After they had disappeared, Klaw came out of hiding, and took the unconscious body of Ms. Marvel prisoner. Paibok's triumph was short-lived, though -- once on Throneworld he discovered that Devos was a wanted criminal, a renegade with a price on his head and an entire world under his command. Devos promptly summoned his troops, took personal command of his ship and attempted to destroy Throneworld. The Empress blamed Paibok for this and repaid him by ordering his death. Seeking to redeem himself, Paibok made his way on board the ship and confronted Devos. The ship's stardrive was damaged during their confrontation and the cruiser fell into subspace -- Devos and Paibok were both believed lost along with the ship. ===Earthfall=== Paibok somehow escaped from subspace and allied himself with a number of Symbiotes, battling both the Human Torch and Spider-Man. He later led a contingent of Skrull forces to Earth to capture the infant Watcher, Talmadge, but was stopped by the Thing and Kree forces and arrested. While being transported to the Kyln, the prison ship crashed in Alaska where he led the surviving prisoners in enslaving the native populace to repair what could be salvaged from the prison ship to leave Earth. Drax the Destroyer, who was also on the prison ship, killed the other alien convicts and not wishing to engage in battle with Drax and wanting to get off Earth, he used a beacon he took from the corpse of a guard to hail another prison ship to collect them. ===Annihilation=== However, while imprisoned in the Kyln the Annihilation Wave broke out which destroyed the Kyln. He was captured by Annihilus' forces and enslaved with mind-control parasites. Thus he fought for Annihilus throughout the Annihilation incident. When Annihilus was defeated by Nova, the mind-control stopped having any effect and he escaped with Terrax and The Delinquent to a minor planet controlled by Randau the Space Parasite who had enslaved the native population and the crews of any ships that passed the planet. Together, they defeated Randau, whereupon Paibok (who accompanied Delinquent) and Terrax went on their separate ways. ===S.W.O.R.D.=== Following the unification of the Skrull and Kree Empires into the Alliance, Paibok became an ambassador for the new regime to S.W.O.R.D.. After the Super-Skrull left the Galactic Council, Paibok replaced him to represent the Alliance.

paige guthrie.name: Paige Guthrie
paige guthrie.origin: ===Early Life=== After her older brother Sam's mutant powers manifested and he joined the New Mutants, Paige tried many things to discover whether she was also a mutant, but became frustrated after many failures. Venting her anger, Paige finally found that her power was to shed her skin. She kept her nature secret until the day Sam and his X-Force teammate Boom Boom visited the farm. They were abducted by the Fenris twins as part of the "Younghunt," a contest involving the capture of young mutants. The X-Force teamed up with the New Warriors, whose member Firestar had also been captured. Together they opposed the organizer of the contest, the Gamesmaster. Paige secretly followed them and confronted the Gamesmaster, defeating him in a game of wits. ===Generation X=== Soon after, Paige was kidnapped by the techno-organic alien Phalanx, who sought to learn how to assimilate mutants into their collective. Paige and her fellow abductees were rescued by an ad-hoc X-Men team, and subsequently became founding members of Generation X, a team of mutants enrolled at the new Massachusetts branch of Xavier's School. thumb|left|180px|With Jono During her time there, Paige studied to become a better X-Man than Sam. She also romanced her teammate Chamber, although their relationship was strained and terminated more than once because of his self-sabotaging. ===Xavier Institute=== Some time after the school was closed, Paige was recruited by her former headmaster Banshee into his paramilitary X-Corps. After that group was dismantled, Paige went to study at the re-established Xavier Institute. Her interest in environmental issues led to her discovering corruption within Worthington Enterprises, the company owned by the X-Man Archangel. Investigating, she and Archangel encountered the Dominant Species, and she was almost killed. Archangel saved her with his healing ability, after which they became romantically involved. thumb|right|180px|With Angel Having finally graduated to the ranks of the X-Men, Paige later aided Archangel in establishing the global mutant outreach program Mutantes Sans Frontières. Setting up office in Zanzibar, they became involved in an attempt by the Hellfire Club to destabilize the country by employing the mercenary Weaponeers. Alongside the country's President, who was secretly the superhero Askari, as well as reinforcements from Genosha, the heroes managed to repel the invaders. Her younger brother Josh later joined the New Mutants Squad under the codename Icarus. Her sister Melody also joined the school as Aero after discovering she could fly, but was depowered on M-Day, although Paige herself retained her powers. ===San Francisco=== Husk later clashed with the O*N*E after they attempted to confiscate her personal items, and hacked into their computers in retaliation. Following the murder and subsequent funeral of her brother Jay, Husk returned home to Kentucky before rejoining the X-Men in San Francisco to help repel the Skrulls invasion. She was also seen in Utopia, fighting against Norman Osborn's Dark Avengers. ===Necrosha=== During the Necrosha event, Husk was part of the team that was sent to Muir Island to investigate. Paige fought, but she too was possessed by the villain Proteus, who gained the ability to possess more than just one host. While possessing her, he demonstrated husking into a flaming form. Eventually, Paige was freed from Proteus, and he was defeated by Magneto. ===Second Coming=== Later, she was seen in the San Francisco Subway, fighting Nimrods alongside Avalanche, Sunspot, and Boom-Boom. As the team seemed to be struggling with the Nimrod, Paige tried husking into a corrosive form to try dissolving the Nimrod. The robot used his technology to acclimate to this form and literally ripped it from her body. It took the combined efforts of the whole team to defeat the robot, but just as it was destroyed, two more arrived and the team was forced to fight. Later, it seemed the team defeated the Nimrods in the tunnels as Paige joined the fight on the Golden Gate Bridge where she witnessed the defeat of the Nimrods, wondering what had caused them to malfunction. ===Curse of the Mutants=== After Paige's old teammate Jubilee was turned into a vampire, Paige made it her mission to find her. Pretending to be a helpless girl, she let a vampire take her to an abandoned warehouse where he tried to bite her. However, under her skin, she assumed a wooden form. Throwing him off her, she demanded to know where Jubilee was. The lights turned on, revealing a group of vampires in the room. After they refused to give her information, Paige shredded her skin to reveal the wooden, spiked form. She attacked the vampires, staking them with her arms and legs, one by one, but they didn't have any information on her friend. After this, Paige returned to Utopia where she joined the strike force against the vampires. Paige yet again assumed her spiked, wooden form and took down several vamps before she was

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.origin: ===Early Life=== Little is known about Paladin's life before becoming a professional mercenary. His real name and the source of his superhuman physical abilities remain unrevealed. Paladin formerly served in the United States Army. During the early stages of his mercenary career, one of his mentors was an old Army associate who later operated as a mercenary called the General. The General was eventually killed by Elektra, causing Paladin to hold a grudge against her for years. Later Paladin participated in the liberation of a prominent Russian nuclear physicist. As a consequence of the operation, he was warned never to return to Russia. Paladin subsequently developed a reputation as an expensive private investigator and gun-for-hire whose services were generally available only to wealthy clients. ===Meeting Daredevil=== Paladin was hired by Mort Chisholm to locate the Purple Man, who had previously used Chisholm while under the influence of his powers. Paladin initially demanded $500,000 for the assignment, although he accepted $450,000 when Chisholm arrived short of the agreed amount. Knowing that Daredevil had recently encountered Killgrave, Paladin followed him. The two fought across the rooftops until Paladin revealed that he was also searching for Purple Man. Paladin continued pursuing Killgrave's associates and later encountered Daredevil while tracking one of Purple Man's henchmen in Central Park. Frustrated by Daredevil's interference, Paladin stunned him and continued the pursuit. Paladin was subsequently hired as a bodyguard by Marsha Connors, whose former boyfriend Phantasm was threatening her. After Marsha appeared to have been killed, Paladin furiously pursued Phantasm before discovering that she had survived. Paladin eventually tracked Purple Man to his headquarters, where Killgrave was holding Heather Glenn hostage and controlling Gladiator, Cobra, Mister Hyde, and Jester. Purple Man attempted to control Paladin, but Paladin fired first and sealed his armor against Killgrave's pheromones before joining Daredevil in defeating the controlled villains. When Purple Man apparently disappeared following the battle, Paladin complained that the loss of his quarry had cost him his fee. ===Defenders for a Day=== After seeing a television advertisement announcing that the Defenders were seeking new members, Paladin travelled to the Richmond Riding Academy. He joined the numerous heroes assembled there as the informal "Defenders for a Day ", but soon decided to leave. ===Thermo=== Christine Michaels hired Paladin to locate her husband Walter Michaels, who had been transformed into the energy-draining criminal Thermo following a laboratory accident. Spider-Man initially mistook Paladin for a criminal while both were searching for Thermo, but the misunderstanding was resolved and the two began working together. Christine supplied Paladin with a nullifier designed to counter Thermo's powers. With the assistance of Dazzler, Paladin and Spider-Man eventually located Thermo and his captives. Paladin repeatedly used the nullifier during the confrontation, helping defeat Thermo before collecting his payment. Paladin was later transported with numerous other superhumans during the Contest of Champions, although he was not selected as an active contestant. ===Wasp=== Paladin was hired to protect valuables at a casino on Utopia Cay. While there, he encountered Wasp and introduced himself under the alias Paul Denning. The two became romantically involved during their stay. When Baron Brimstone and his men attacked the casino, Paladin revealed his costumed identity and fought beside Wasp. Afterward, he admitted that Paul was not his real name. Around this period Paladin adopted a modified version of his costume and continued his relationship with Janet, who was then separated from Hank Pym. Businessman Vince Granetti later hired Paladin to force Janet to surrender her business interests. Although Paladin publicly appeared to carry out the intimidation, he covertly warned Janet about Granetti's intentions. He ultimately sided with Wasp and Spider-Man against his employer. After completing another lucrative assignment, Paladin accompanied Janet to question Yellowjacket. When members of the Masters of Evil intervened, Paladin assisted Wasp and the Avengers against Grey Gargoyle and Screaming Mimi. Paladin remained openly flirtatious toward Janet during their association, while Black Knight, who was himself attracted to Wasp, regarded their relationship with jealousy. Paladin and Janet eventually went their separate ways. ===International Investigations=== Newspaper publisher Emmette Edison hired Paladin to locate his supposedly kidnapped daughter Dixie Edison. The apparent kidnapping eventually led him into a much larger conspiracy involving toxic waste, an international crime syndicate, the KGB, and extraterrestrial manipulators. Paladin travelled through the United States, Italy, Russia, and Antarctica during the inve

palamedes.name: Palamedes
palamedes.origin: Palamedes was the son of the Euboian King. He was presumably among the suitors of Helen of Sparta, and swore a loyalty oath to the one she would choose, Menelaus. When Paris of Troy came to Sparta and stole with his love Helen (and treasures of Sparta), Menelaus called for the princes that had swore loyalty to him. Along with Menelaus and his brother Agamemnon, Palamedes went to Ithaca to rally Odysseus. Foretold that he would return only in twenty years, Odysseus pretended to have gone mad, ploughing a field with an ox and a donkey and flinging salt instead of seeds. Palamedes saw through the ruse, and put Odysseus' baby Telemachus on the course of the plow, forcing the King of Ithaca to stop pretending madness and join the crew, but causing him to grow antagonistic towards Palamedes. Later, Palamades went along with Menelaus and Odysseus to Troy to demand to King Priam to return both Helen and the treasures, but their claim was dismissed by Priam. Palamedes and Odysseus' rivalry soon escalated, when Palamedes mocked Odysseus' inability to find corn after an expedition to Thrace, and then managed to find some himself. Odysseus' honor was wounded. Some days later, Palamedes was found drowned during a fishing expedition. It was stated that Palamedes had stated to go on such expedition with Odysseus and Diomedes, but Odysseus called it a lie and threatened anyone repeating it. At that point, it was whispered that Diomedes and Odysseus were the murderers of Palamedes. Achilles was suspected as well.

palatyne.name: Palatyne
palatyne.origin: Pressyne, daughter of the serpent lower-bodied demoness Maralith and descendant of Set, took on the form of a fairy and married Elynas on the condition he would not see her in labor. When Pressyne did gave birth to triplet daughters, but Elynas rushed into the birthing chamber, causing Pressyne to depart with her daughters, Melusine, Melior, and Palatyne, and flee to the lost isle of Avalon. On their 15th birthday, Melusine learned the reason for their banishment, and consequently led her sisters to capture Elynas and imprison him in a mountain. Learning about it, an angered Pressyne punished her daughters for their disrespect. Palatyne was imprisoned with her father's treasure on a mountaintop in Arragorn. With an unidentified mate, and under unrevealed circumstances (though apparently in Lemuria), Palatyne gave birth to the Lemurian Nagala, a potential mother for the seventh generation descendant of Set, prophetized to restore the kingdom of the Serpents (another one could be Yith, daughter of Melusine).

pale horse.name: Pale Horse
pale horse.origin: Pale Horse was one of the surviving members of the Order of the Glorious End after the performance of a ritual that summoned the cosmic entity of Death. However, she was subsequently kidnapped. Death's disappearance made dying impossible across the entire universe. When Thanos and Deadpool investigated the disappearance of their mistress, they ended up in the base of the Order, the Dwindling Light. Pale Horse and the other remaining members of the Order engaged them in combat before discovering they also worshipped Death. The Order offered the two intruders all the information they could give in exchange for their deaths at the hands of Thanos as soon as Death was recovered. The Guardians of the Galaxy arrived to the Dwindling Light soon after, to track down Thanos, believing Death's disappearance to be his deed. The Order helped Thanos and Deadpool get the Guardians off their back until they could escape and continue their search.

pale mist.name: Pale Mist
pale mist.origin: Pale Mist was the daughter of the Chief of the Utabi Tribe and promised to Bright Eagle, the greatest warrior of the Shawmis Tribe, in order to seal a peace pact between the two tribes. The marriage was opposed by Crooked Knife who loved Pale Mist and resented the Shawmis after years of battle against them. However, the Chief was unmoved when Crooked Knife failed to convince him to prevent this union. In retaliation he gathered other braves who had suffered losses against the Shawmis to join his cause. They disguised themselves as Shawmis warriors and murdered the group escorting Pale Mist in the hopes of framing the Shawmis. Pale Mist recognized the disguised warriors, particularly Crooked Knife and fled away in fear, only to run into the Black Rider, who forced the renegades away. Crooked Knife in turn turned both the Utabi and Shawmis against the Black Rider by convincing all of them that he had kidnapped Pale Mist for himself. Crooked Knife's plot fell apart when the Black Rider, in his alter-ego of Frontier doctor Matthew Masters went to the Utabi village and convinced both the Utabi chief and Bright Eagle of Crooked Knife's plot. Crooked Knife later attempted to kill Bright Eagle in his teepee, however, it has been a plot to catch him and Bright Eagle killed him in combat. Pale Mist was reunited with her people and was soon married to Bright Eagle. The fate of Pale Mist of the other members of the Utabi tribe has not been revealed.

pallas athena.name: Pallas Athena
pallas athena.origin: ===Origin=== 250px|thumb|left|Birth of Athena Athena was the daughter of the Titaness Metis and Zeus, He impregnated her, before he was foretold by the Fates that their child would be greater than him. Zeus consequently consumed Metis in an attempt to prevent that prophecy. Nine months later, Zeus was afflicted with violent headaches. Hephaestus trephined him, giving birth to a fully grown and armored Athena. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Medusa, Euryale and Stheno, daughters of Phorcys and Ceto worshiped Olympian gods rather than their grandfather Set. Medusa was a chaste priestess of Athena, as were her sisters, having all taken a vow of celibacy. Despite her vow, she was seduced by Poseidon and fell to his advances on Athena's altar. Enraged, Athena cursed the three sisters (and their descendants) as snake-haired creatures (possibly by releasing their true nature, as those features were shared by their aunt Ishiti and her offspring known as the Man-Serpents). ===Ancient Greece=== Athena later joined the Olympians on Olympus being worshiped by the humans of Ancient Greece. The city of Athens was named in her honor after she won a contest between her and her uncle, the sea-god Poseidon to decide who would lay claim to the city. Poseidon gave the people a salty spring to curry their favor but they ultimately chose Athena over Poseidon when the goddess provided an olive tree that was more useful. Thus, she became the patron goddess of Athens. ====Medusa and Perseus==== In 2000 BC, she led the hero Perseus to the location of Medusa. She gave him magical shield. After his success she carved the Gorgon's head on her shield. ====The Eternals==== Zeus discovered Olympia, home to the superhumanly long-lived offshoot of humanity known as the Eternals, who resided near the gods' home of Olympus itself. Olympia was the capital city of the Eternals and was ruled by Zuras. Zeus and Athena then traveled to Olympia to meet with Zuras and his daughter Azura, named after her father. Athena noticed the physical resemblances between Zeus and Zuras and herself and Azura and hence suggested a pact of non-interference between the two races, where the Olympian Eternals would act as the gods' heralds on Earth at certain times. The pact was sealed and Azura changed her name to Thena to honor the pact. ====Arachne==== Her brother Ares told Athena of a mortal woman, Arachne, who claimed to be a better weaver then her. This caused Athena to bring Arachne to Ares for judgement over daring to make herself appear better than the gods, and appeared to have been executed for this. Unbeknownst to the Olympians, Arachne was secretly a herald of the trickster god Anansi, and desiring justice for her ignited a war between them and the African gods. Once the war subsided, Athena felt guilt for what happened to Arachne and resurrected her into the form of a creature with a spider body instead of legs. ====Tiresias==== Tiresias once stumbled upon Athena while she was bathing. As a result, the goddess decided to blind him. His mother begged Athena to lift the curse, but she refused to. Instead, she opened Tiresias' ears so he might hear all the whispers of the Gods. This two curses/gifts gave him a greater perspective of the world. ====Hercules==== As the Fates had prophesized that no god could slay the giants, but a mortal bearing the lion's sign, Athena convinced Zeus to conceive such a creature, Hercules, which would give them the upper hand in the coming Gigantomachy. Centuries ago Athena used foresight to predict the birth of Amadeus Cho and the events of the World War Hulk, predicting that while the still young Hercules would grow to be a force for good, Amadeus would always be her champion, foretelling the modern times and his final choosing in becoming a force for good himself, and her and Hercules's helper. ====Kyknos==== In 1268 BC, Hercules clashed with Ares' son Kyknos. Athena and Ares asked the Fates if Hercules would best him. They replied that Hercules would slay Kyknos unless he were killed first. Ares intervened on the battle to assist his son, but Athena came to Hercules' aid in order to level the playing field. Ultimately, Hercules succeeded in slaying Kyknos. ====Trojan War==== Athena also participated in the Trojan War taking the side of the Greeks against the Trojans to avenge, at least in her mind, an insult performed on her by the Trojan prince Paris. Paris had deemed Venus as the most beautiful goddess of all after a contest was formed among Venus, Athena and Hera to be judged as "the most beautiful". During the war, Athena fought against Ares, and empowered Diomedes so that he could strike Ares a near-mortal wound. ====Odyssey==== Odysseus whom she aided in returning home to Ithaca from the Trojan War and reclaiming his kingdom. ===Roman Empire=== In 146 B.C., the Romans conquered Macedonia and then Greece. They even adopted Olympian Gods, changing many of their names in the process. Athena became "Minerva". ===20th Century=

palmer addley.name: Palmer Addley
palmer addley.origin: ===Origin=== Dr. Palmer Addley was a brilliant researcher D.A.R.P.A., until he committed suicide which he filmed. He was pronounced dead leaving only a mystery of why he did it. ===Palmer Addley is Dead=== A few months later all of Dr. Addley's projects started shutting down mysteriously. Dr. Addley's offensive weaponry projects began falling in the hands of the wrong people and attack occurred across the globe leaving the message "Palmer Addley is dead". The government investigated and Dr. Addley was proven to still be dead. ===Iron Man=== James Rhodes now going by Iron Man was sent on missions on behalf the US government. He was sent to investigate the attack. He followed a lead to Russia were he walked into a trap his armor was crippled by a virus and he was then hit with a nuclear weapon. After getting a new armor he discovered that Dr. Addley had developed a Nano Tech virus that he transferred his consciousness into. Having infected himself with this virus, he killed himself so that his organs would be distributed to needy people, thereby infecting them with his virus. Those infected with Dr. Addley's virus would soon unwittingly start developing his weaponry and sending it out into the world.

paloma.name: Paloma
paloma.origin: The Paloma program was originally created by the Pixel Corporation before being junked in the recesses of cyberspace. Wire and Doom inadvertently found Paloma while lost in cyberspace, and reactivated her. Paloma took control of the Pixel Corp and became an ally of Doom, diverting Pixel's material wealth to his cause while declaring cyberspace her domain. Paloma aided Doom in the revolution attack on America, but also revealed herself to be a fickle goddess of the 'net by altering the nature of cyberspace so that the death of an avatar meant the death of the user in real life.

pamela douglas.name: Pamela Douglas
pamela douglas.origin: Pamela Douglas was an editor for a business trade journal called The Manhattan Project. She lived a normal life until she started feeling a presence in her head. In fact, it was her estranged cousin Heather (Moondragon), who had lost her physical body and had sought refuge in her closest living relative, Pamela. After a while, Heather was finally able to establish contact and told her cousin everything, requesting her help to get to Titan, where the supercomputer ISAAC has started creating a cloned body for her mind to inhabit. 150px|thumb|left|Shaved Hair Pamela was then attacked by two giant hands, which they came to learn belonged to the disembodied soul of Isaac Christians. Known as the Gargoyle, Isaac had been one of Moondragon's teammates on the Defenders, who had seemingly lost his life when she was corrupted by the Dragon of the Moon. They were able to calm down Isaac Christians' soul and make amends. Then, Pamela took the crystal that contained Isaac's soul to keep it safe close to her. Taveling in Moondragon's old ship, they made their way to Titan, where the locals made Pamela feel welcome, while they waited for Moondragon's clone to reach gestation. During this time, Pamela began to fall in love with a Titan named Demeityr. When gestation day arrived, Moondragon and Pamela discovered that once the baby clone was imprinted with Moondragon's soul, the baby would be given to the care of the Priests of Shao-Lom and Pamela would be returned to Earth. Both Pamela and Moondragon violently objected to these terms. At first, it looked as if they would have to give in to the powerful Titan leader Mentor, but Isaac Christians' soul spoke up and asked Mentor to remand the two women into his care. Mentor had come to know and respect Isaac Christians, so he agreed. Pamela, the cloned infant of Moondragon, and the soul of Isaac Christians then started on a tour of the galaxy in Moondragon's spaceship. Just after leaving Titan, their spaceship was pulled into a giant ship belonging to the mysterious Dance. Moondragon told Pamela that the powerful race moved through the universe and performed a variety of seemingly random acts. No one knew why. 150px|thumb|right|With Baby Heather The Dance members started forcing Pamela and the others into a column of fusion-level plasma. pamela grayson.name: Pamela Grayson
pamela grayson.origin: Pamela Grayson was the best friend of Judy Laughton, an employee at the secret prison where the Absorbing Man was being held. Shortly after Judy apparently committed suicide by throwing herself in front of a subway train, Pamela met Bruce Banner, who had spoken to Judy moments before her death. As they discussed the tragedy, Pamela was unknowingly targeted by the Absorbing Man's newly developed psychic abilities, which allowed him to possess her mind intermittently. Under his influence she attacked muggers, struck Banner, and later attempted to push him in front of a subway train, though she remembered none of these incidents afterward. After Banner saved her life, the two realized that Judy's death and Pamela's blackouts were connected to Carl Creel's imprisonment. Pamela recognized Creel from television after experiencing disturbing visions while under his influence, leading her and Banner to conclude that the villain was mentally controlling people from inside his prison. While searching Judy's apartment for answers, Pamela discovered confidential information that allowed her to contact Dr. David Zhan, although Warden Johnson prevented the warning from reaching him. When Creel began controlling a young girl to force Banner into helping him escape, Pamela followed Banner to New Jersey aboard a train bound for the town hiding the secret prison. Determined to avenge Judy's death and stop Creel, she refused to abandon Banner despite the danger and remained by his side as they tracked the source of the psychic attacks. After Banner infiltrated the prison under Creel's coercion, Pamela helped rescue the possessed child and reached the underground complex during the ensuing battle between the Hulk and the Absorbing Man. There she learned of Dr. Zhan's dying clue and realized that Creel's psychic power required a living mind to inhabit. Using Zhan's corpse as bait, Pamela deceived the Absorbing Man into abandoning his own body in order to search the dead scientist's mind for information. Trapped within a lifeless brain, Creel found himself unable to escape as his physical body dissolved, apparently defeating him. With the crisis over, Pamela bid farewell to Bruce Banner before he disappeared once again into anonymity.

pamela hawley.name: Pamela Hawley
pamela hawley.origin: Lady Pamela Hawley was Nick Fury's girlfriend when he was stationed in England during WWII. They met during a German air raid and fell in love. Her father was the nobleman Lord Hawley. In 1943, Pamela, Nick and "Dum Dum" Dugan encountered an amnesiac woman who was wandering aimlessly in London. When the woman called Pamela by name, they decided to take care of her until they could get her some help. The three of them were soon approached in a pub by a man who introduced himself as Dr. Stephen Strange. Secretly Earth's Sorcerer Supreme from decades in the future, Strange revealed that the woman was his friend, Morgana Blessing, and claimed that she was suffering from partial amnesia due to several serious psychic traumas that she had experienced in recent days. Without revealing that he and Morgana were both from the future, Strange left Morgana in Pamela's care while he made preparations to restore her memory. That night, Morgana was kidnapped from Hawley Manor by Sir Anthony Baskerville who needed her as part of a ritual to incarnate Dormammu on Earth. Fearing that Pamela might have seen his face, Baskerville kidnapped her as well. The scheme by Baskerville and his allies was ultimately thwarted, and Doctor Strange used his magic to cause Pamela, Nick and Dum Dum to forget what had happened. Later that year, Pamela wrote a Christmas card and sent it to Nick. However, the envelope containing the card was lost behind a file cabinet in a British post office. Sometime later, Lady Pamela Hawley died during another German bombing raid in London before Fury, who had bought an engagement ring, had a chance to propose to her. Decades later, when the post office was razed, the long-lost envelope was found and sent to Colonel Nick Fury in the United States who received it just before Christmas. Pamela was reportedly reincarnated into the identity of Morgana Blessing.

fields.notes: There is conflicting in-story evidence as to exactly when Pamela Hawley's relationship with Nick Fury occurred. On the one hand, depicts Pamela and Nick as being a couple in the year 1943, and showed Nick (in the present-day of 1993) receiving a long-lost Christmas card from Pamela that had been mailed back in 1943. On the other hand, showed Pamela and Nick together on a date soon after he had returned from Okinawa, Japan, where he and the Howling Commandos had rescued a captured Allied spy just before the Battle of Okinawa began, an event that occurred in the real world on April 1st, 1945. Additionally, the captured spy was Colonel Phil "Pillbox" Parker, someone with whom Fury had served during the Battle of the Bulge, which in the real world had been fought from December 16th, 1944, to January 28th, 1945. If the "Okinawa" and "Battle of the Bulge" references in that Sgt. Fury issue are correct, then Pamela's death in could not have occurred any earlier than mid-April of 1945. And if the "1943" references are also correct, then that would mean that their relationship began sometime in 1943 and lasted a minimum of 16 months before ending when she died. Although Pamela's father did testify that he had known Nick Fury for "many months" in , there's really no other in-story evidence that they had been a couple for anywhere near that long a time. The only other explanation is that some of the dates are wrong. Either Pamela met Nick in 1943 and died sometime in 1944, or she died in 1945 and didn't meet Nick until sometime in 1944. The fact shows that "Junior" Juniper, who died in the same issue in which Pamela was introduced, was part of a mission to rescue a captured French Resistance leader who knew the time and place of D-Day does suggest that Pamela must have met Nick sometime after early 1944. Having said that, it should be noted that the continuity between the Sgt. Fury series and the real WWII timeline has been described as being "all over the place." When Doctor Strange first met Pamela Hawley, he speculated that she and Morgan Blessing, who slightly resembled each other, might have been "astral twins." However, Strange later discovered that Pamela and Morgana were actually different incarnations of the same soul, one that had already lived hundreds upon hundreds of lives over the course of millennia.
fields.trivia: Pamela held the title of "Lady", which is a formal title in the United Kingdom. The women entitled to use it include women with titles of nobility or honorary titles suo jure (in her own right), female members of the Order of the Garter and the Order of the Thistle, the wives of lords, baronets, Scottish feudal barons, lairds, or knights, and the daughters of dukes, marquesses, and earls. Widows and former wives of knights retain their married style until their death or until their marriage to someone else.

pamela kramer.name: Pamela Kramer
pamela kramer.origin: Pamela "Pam" Kramer was the daughter of Michael Kramer, a former pilot of an all-black American air force fighter squadron in World War II who, in 1944, had been captured in Germany and subjected to genetic alterations to make him host of, while immune to, a genocidal biological weapon called the Judas Plague. Michael, codenamed the Judas Man, was rescued and the laboratory was destroyed. As the Judas Plague required a catalyst to activate it, which was believed destroyed in the lab, Michael felt he could have a normal life and hid his past. When Michael had a daughter, the genetic changes were inherited and her body came to have the antidote to the Judas plague, even though they were unaware of it. Living on the West Coast, Pamela grew up loving her father and, when she was old enough, she enrolled in law school at the University of California, Berkeley, with one of her professors being Adam Ishima. During Pamela's first year of college, Michael began to be harassed by thugs sent by the nihilistic villain Viper, who wanted to get Michael to spread the plague through the United States of America. Viper had obtained the catalyst that would allow him to activate the plague, and had also discovered that Pamela had the cure for the plague, so he decided to kidnap Pamela as well. After months of chasing, Michael became frightened, and Pamela saw his behavior and attitude change; despite this, Michael did not tell Pamela the reason why he was being persecuted. Eventually, Michael abandoned Pamela to try to escape the country by boat. Pamela called the SFPD for help, but they paid no attention to her, at least not to her satisfaction. Wanting to hire a private investigator, Pamela listened to the recommendation of her professor Adam Ishima and decided to present her case to researcher Jessica Drew, who had helped Ishima's brother shortly before with good results for a reasonable price, something that Pamela appreciated because she didn't have too much money. When Pamela went to Drew's office in the Hunter-Dulin Building in San Francisco after class, she was openly accosted by three Viper agents (Deke, Freddie and Gino) in an aircar and armed with high-tech weapons, who attempted to abduct her on the spot; Viper, eager to capture Pamela, would have gone in person but did not want it to be known that she was still alive. Although Pamela was outnumbered and forced into the aircar, she resisted long enough to attract the attention of the superheroine Spider-Woman (secretly Jessica Drew), who came to the rescue, leaving Gino behind in the building. When the other two thugs hinted that they were also interested in Pamela's father, she got a second wind, determined to confront the people who had threatened him even if it put her own life in danger, and damaged the delicate mechanisms of the aircar, causing the vehicle to crash into the ground on California Street. With two of the thugs stunned, Spider-Woman helped Pamela recover, claiming to be an associate of Drew's. SFPD Detective Sabrina Morrel showed up to arrest Deke and Freddie and take witness statements, Viper and her second Silver Samurai flew by in a second aircar to activate an explosive grafted to their hitmen and kill them (but Gino, being too far away, was unaffected). Spider-Woman pursued Viper and the Samurai, but failed to apprehend them. Morrel then took Pamela's statement at the Hall of Justice, and when she was done, Pamela talked to Drew about officially hiring her. Pamela was unhappy with the police, who had so far done nothing about her case, and even then she felt that her father was being treated like a criminal. Drew accepted Pamela's case, but seeing that Pamela was in danger of being attacked by Viper again, Drew decided to send her to Drew's personal residence at 1 Yarbro Court, to better protect her with the help of Drew's roommate, actress Lindsay McCabe - who was sleeping when they arrived. McCabe agreed to stay home with Pamela, asking Pamela to help her rehearse, and they set up a prearranged signal for phone calls and contacts (Pamela, not being used to such situations, mistakenly picked up the phone on one occasion, but McCabe promptly hung up on her). Somehow, however, Viper's forces discovered that Pamela had hired Drew and was hiding out at Drew's home. By this time, sorceress Morgan Le Fay had manipulated Viper into believing that she, Viper, was Jessica Drew's long-lost mother, but despite her emotional dismay, Viper went ahead with the plan and attempted to capture Pamela while sending Silver Samurai to get her. Michael; the plan was that the Samurai tailed Drew so that Drew would find Michael for them. As Spider-Woman, Drew convinced Morrel to reinforce Pamela's defense at Yarbro Court; Morrel went there to help (although, since no one had warned them, McCabe was suspicious and demanded proof). At the house, Pamela chatted with McCabe and Morrel, rudely concluding that Morrel was probably jealous of Drew because Drew was better

pamela leighton.name: Pamela Leighton
pamela leighton.origin: Pamela Leighton was one of the people who gained paranormal powers as a result of the White Event, in her case the ability to control the emotions of others via touch. She seemed to favor using her power on men in order to cause them to be attracted to her sexually, but it is unknown whether this was a limit to her power or just a personal preference as to how she used it. Pamela admitted herself to the Clinic for Paranormal Research in Wisconsin, and was assigned to Therapy Group B, a group who had an antagonistic relationship with Therapy Group D. Despite that, Pamela was attracted to Therapy Group D's Randy O'Brien, and on more than one occasion tried to use her power on him to make him return her feelings. When the patients were assigned work duties to ease the burden on the Clinic's small staff, Pamela took on a job as a food server in the cafeteria. During the police raid that closed the Clinic, Pamela tried to make a run for it with two other patients, Sally 'Shock' Gallagher and John 'Scrap Iron' Rost. They failed, and during the patients' final stand against the police, Pamela was shot in the stomach. It is unknown if she survived the shooting.

pamela shaw.name: Pamela Shaw
pamela shaw.species: Human granted superhuman powers and abilities by Seth
pamela shaw.origin: After the tragic death of her baby and abandonment by her husband, Pamela Shaw decided that she would take her own life. She was brought to a New York hospital where she was kidnapped by the Heliopolitan god of death, Seth, and given a second chance at life. In exchange for killing Seth's enemy, Hogun the Grim, Pamela would be made whole once more. However, a mere mortal would not be up to the task of killing an Asgardian god, so Seth put the glowing sign of Aton in the palm of her hand, which gave her the awesome powers of Wind Warrior. However, if she failed to kill Hogun, her life would be forfeited once more. Wind Warrior and the rest of Earth Force fought the Thunder god, Thor, who was protecting his Asgardian ally, but she decided to listen to the words of Earth Lord and reevaluate her actions. Earth Force left the scene only to return on the side of the angels. Together with Thor, the Black Knight and the other Asgardians and their allies, Wind Warrior opposed the legions of Seth. However, Wind Warrior escaped capture as the others were taken captive by Grog, the God crusher, to the Black Pyramid. Not knowing if she would return to help them, she wandered the realm of death when she accidentally stumbled upon the other Heliopolitan gods that were left powerless by Seth. Wind Warrior mustered up the courage and returned to her teammates, eventually challenging the god of death to a fight. In the end, Seth defeated Earth Force, nearly killing them, but when Seth was defeated, Wind Warrior and the others were healed by the other gods of Egypt and returned to Earth. Pamela Shaw, like the other members of Earth Force, was allowed to keep her powers. She would again be called into action when the menace that is Bloodaxe had a run in with Doctor Strange. Looking for a woman named Susan Austin, Bloodaxe attracted the attention of Earth's sorcerer supreme, and Bloodaxe assaulted Doctor Strange unprovoked. Strange would not allow Bloodaxe's actions to go unchallenged, and he fought back against his unknown foe. The resulting clash brought the police and their special task force Code: Blue into the fray. Wind Warrior's teammate, Earth Lord, in the guise of police officer Kyle Brock was at the scene, and it was he who sent the summons for help. Shaw answered along with Earth Force member, Skyhawk, and they combined forces with Code: Blue to battle Bloodaxe. After Susan Austin was saved during Earth Lord's initial attack, Bloodaxe was powerful enough to fend off both teams. That was until he decided to create a vortex using the Executioner's axe. Wind Warrior flew into the vortex and used her power to turn Bloodaxe's creation against him as she created a spinning prison. She knew that the vortex would not hold him for long, so Code: Blue, under Doctor Strange's influence, tried to subdue Bloodaxe with a grenade. After the smoke cleared from the grenade's explosion, Bloodaxe was nowhere to be found. The two teams felt they earned a victory and were satisfied that a woman's life was saved, and the city was not left in shambles. It is presumed that Pamela Shaw went back to her normal life, but it is possible that Wind Warrior may be called into action again someday.

pammon.name: Pammon
pammon.origin: Pammon was one of the many sons of King Priam of Troy. He fought for his city during the Trojan War, after his brother Paris had stolen Helen from her husband Menelaus, king of Sparta. When the Argives eventually entered the city at the tenth year of the war, Menelaus led Diomedes and Achilles' son Neoptolemus to Priam's throne room. Priam had deserted it, but Neoptolemus found his sons Pammon, Polites, and Antiphonus there, whom he each slew in an instant.

pan olympian god.name: Pan (Olympian God)
pan olympian god.origin: ===Early Life=== Pan was the son of Hermes and of the mortal Thessalian princess Dryope. Pan was on Olympus when Hephaestus caught his wife Aphrodite cheating on him with Ares he dragged them around the city in a net. Pan was one of the spectators laughing. After the Gigantomachy, Gaea gave birth to Typhon to seek vengeance against the gods. Typhon assaulted Olympus and bested Zeus. Along with Hermes, Pan made Typhon consume mortal food, sickening him and allowing Zeus to defeat him in a second clash. ===Roman Empire=== In 146 B.C., the Romans conquered Macedonia and then Greece. They even adopted Olympian Gods, changing many of their names in the process. Pan became "Faunus". ===20th Century=== A man with his date at the museum laughs at the painting of Pan. The museum guard chastises him for it, and he leaves. Later, his date sees him on the street and asks him why his hair has fallen out. He doesn't tell her that, as they were leaving the museum, he looked back at the guard walking down the hall and saw that the man had cloven hooves. ===Modern Era=== Pan was present at party on Olympus for the Hulk hosted by Dionysus. ====Olympus Group==== Pan and the other Olympians settled on Earth forming the company the Olympus Group. Pan was on Olympus when the Hulks attacked.

pandarus of lycia.name: Pandarus of Lycia
pandarus of lycia.origin: Pandarus was a prince of Lycia who fought the Argives during the Trojan War. In the last year of the war, during a truce, wishing to see Troy destroyed, Athena swayed Pandarus to shoot an arrow at Menelaus, promising him glory and Paris' thanks. The arrow was deflected by Thor's powers, but Agamemnon declared the truce over due to that "cowardly" act, while tre Trojans were sorry but refused the insult. The fighting resumed, and Aeneas called for Pandarus to mount on his chariot and attack the Argives together. They spotted and targeted Diomedes, mightiest Argive as Achilles refused to battle. Diomedes being protected and guided by Athena was able to struck and killed Pandarus from a javelin stroke between his eyes. Feeling responsible, Aeneas rushed to stand guard over Pandarus' body, but was himself targeted by Diomedes, only to be saved by the interventions of his mother Aphrodite and of Ares.

pandemonia.name: Pandemonia
pandemonia.origin: Pandemonia was the succubus daughter of a lesser Chaos Lord who terrorised central Europe during the middle ages. Despite her power, she was eventually defeated by a Roma sorcerer who imprisoned her on Mount Sorcista in Latveria. There she remained trapped for six centuries. When the mutants Locus and Skids accidentally teleported to Latveria, Pandemonia saw an opportunity to escape. Enslaving them, she forced Locus to use her portals to transport her to California, where she used her powers to mind control most of X-Force. She was eventually defeated by Jennifer Kale, who banished her back to her home dimension.

pandora.name: Pandora
pandora.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Pandora, in Greek mythology, the first woman. After Prometheus stole fire from Olympus and gave it to mankind, Zeus decided to punish the mortals by sending them Pandora. He also gave her a "Box" which was actually a "Urn" containing all manner of misery and evil. He told her to never open it. Zeus sent her to Epimetheus who made Pandora his wife. She afterwards opened the box, from which the evils flew out over the Earth. Hope alone remained inside, the lid having been shut down before she could escape. Pandora was exiled to an island in the Pacific ages ago after defying the will of Zeus and unleashing all the evils in the world from her black box. Then, the Eternal sorcerer Sersi, under the identity of Circe, gathered the evils back into the Box and shut it with a spell. ===20th century=== In the 20th century, a shipwreck survivor named Dan Harper found himself washed up on Pandora's island and she tricked him into opening the box for her once more, unleashing a monster which she intended to use to conquer the world. Harper, however, escaped to Australia and returned with mirrors with which he surrounded Pandora, shattering the illusion of beauty she projected and revealing her true age. Pandora, unable to bear the sight of herself, agreed to return her creature to the box in return for the removal of the mirrors. Pandora's box was buried in a secret location by the Australian authorities, but Pandora remained on her island, comforted by her illusion of beauty once more. While on a camping vacation to Shadow Mountain, George Ashton encountered Pandora. Although initially tricked into releasing one of the monsters within her cursed box, George defeated Pandora by revealing her true appearance in the reflection of one of his well-shined cooking pans, forcing her to retrieve the Thing in the Black Box.

pandora destine.name: Pandora Destine
pandora destine.origin: Pandora and her twin brother Rory were born in Yden, and hadn't left Yden before the death of Vincent. After the death of Vincent and Adam's self exile into deep space, the twins were place under the guardianship of their siblings Walter and Flo, posing as their uncle and grandmother respectively. When their powers manifested in puberty, Pandora and Rory believed they were mutants. Wanting to become a superhero, Rory convinced Pandora to starting going out on nightly patrols as Crimson Crusader and Imp wearing costumes designed by their "aunt" Kay Cera. For six months, Crimson Crusader and Imp fought crime in and around London and took down the Windsor Gang and Rainbow Quartet. One night during patrol, the twins came upon Alpha and his Omegans fighting Lenz over the Gryphon. Not knowing who to help, the twins took the Gryphon to stop the fight, but Lenz torn off Imp's cape. The Kay Cera Label in the cape led Lenz to Kay Cera in Barcelona. After killing Cera, Lenz learned about the other members of Clan Destine asd dispatched his agents to attack them. Both Maurice and Flo killed, but Walter and Samantha Hasard survived their attacks. To discover why they were being attacked, Walter took the twins to Dominic's Island to recruit their reclusive brother Dominic. After recruiting Dominic, the group travelled to the Griffin Research Complex where Rory, Pandora, and Walter were captured by the Omegans. Before Samantha and Kay could free their siblings, Rory was abducted by one of Lenz's minions. To rescue Rory, his family arrived to trade the Gryphon, but they were overwhelmed until Adam arrived to save them. Following their confrontation with Lenz, Adam began to explain their family heritage to the twins while their older siblings tried to scare them out of being superheroes. Exasperated with the situation, Walter finally put his foot down and forbid the twins from being superheroes. Frustrated with Walter's decision and fearing being separated from each other, Crimson Crusader and Imp ranaway to New York using a hollowed out car to fly across the Atlantic Ocean. In New York, the twins quickly met Spider-Man. Spider-Man tried to convince the twins to return home, and even let them "audition" to be his sidekick. While trying to reunited the twins with Kay and Samantha, but ended up saving the women from the Skyline Killer. Eventually the other adults of Clan Destine convinced Walter to allow the twin to fight crime with each adult taking a turn to chaperone the twins. When Kay Cera was abducted by a demon, Newton created a device allowing Clan Destine to follow and save her. However, the device brought the Clan to the Danger Room where they met the X-Men. While the other Clan adults interacted with the X-Men, Crimson Crusader and Imp were taken on a tour of the X-Mansion by Kitty Pryde and Cannonball and were almost recruited to the team. However, the interactions were revealed to be a corrupted Danger Room program and plot by Synraith to enter the Earthly realm. One night while heading to London to a patrol, Adam vanished in a bolt of lighting while Crimson Crusader and Imp's powers malfunctioned. To get help, the twin carefully traveled to Blasco Castle with the damaged Flight Belt to meet with Kay and Samantha. However, at Belasco Castle, the twins were playfully attacked by Kay's vampyr friends. To find Hex, who was lost in the Multiverse, Newton recruited Crimson Crusader and Imp. Crimson Crusader intuitive power to manipulate gravity allowed him to traverse the Multiverse using the Q-Car and located Hex on Earth-80522 where he and Excalibur being attacked by Tral-controlled Inhumans. After rescuing Hex and Excalibur, they returned to Ravenscroft were they were attacked by Super-Griffin and his clones of Wallop, Crimson Crusader, and Imp. Fortunately, the entire Clan was rescued by the timely intervention of Adam and Elalyth. When Vincent returned to the Earthly plane, Clan Destine travelled to New York to stop Kay Cera from killing him again. Arriving at the American Museum of Natural History, Cuckoo used the powers of Crimson Crusader and Imp to disrupt Vincent's return and the energies from his occult dimension.

pandora peters.name: Pandora Peters
pandora peters.origin: Pandora Peters was the director of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secret Wizardry Alchemy Necromancy Department, also known as W.A.N.D. When it appeared that Doctor Strange had gone rogue, Peters made Ross's Thunderbolts aware of this so they could take him out. To help them in their mission, Ross and the Leader were summoned to W.A.N.D.'s HQ using magic and given free rein of W.A.N.D.'s stores of magical weaponry and artifact. After getting what they needed, Peters had Agent Todd wipe the Thunderbolts' memory of their meeting, and replaced it with a memory of them getting their artifacts after a fight with the ghost of Doctor Druid. The Thunderbolts eventually proved victorious against the evil Doctor Strange, who turned out to actually be the True Fairie king Oberoth'm'gozz in disguise. Peters and her agents of W.A.N.D. arrived at the scene after the king's defeat to clean up the magical mess and to bring back the real Doctor Strange. Peters reintroduced herself to the Thunderbolts and apologized for not handling the situation themselves, as they didn't know this wasn't the real Doctor Strange. Afterwards, she had Todd wipe their memories once again, making them forget about the whole ordeal. After S.H.I.E.L.D. was disbanded, most agents of W.A.N.D. became outlaws and formed the Blasphemy Cartel. Peters became a target of her former agents and went into hiding, becoming the new bartender of the Bar With No Doors. Eventually, the Cartel was dealt with, and Peters reestablished W.A.N.D., alongside Wong.

panhuman uni mind.name: Panhuman Uni-Mind
panhuman uni mind.species: Uni-Mind of Humans; possible future Celestial
panhuman uni mind.origin: ===Origin=== After being taken by the Celestials during the Fourth Host, the Young Gods traveled with them, with no instructions, directions or even attention. After having tried to communicate, even battled them, the Young Gods eventually fell into some form of madness, but eventually realized that the Celestials wanted them to act on their own. Varua eventually had the insight that the Celestials were in fact Uni-Minds from entire planets, encased into armor. ===Creation=== They returned to Earth and created a giant armor in Madripoor, then Varua formed the Panhuman Uni-Mind, intending to put it in the armor, bringing the Celestial Terran to life, for him to take his place into the Fifth Host, and for humanity to unite and be taken to the next level. Madripoor was chosen for the "ascension" because of its rich and poor fractions rigid separation. As all Madripoor inhabitants' consciousnesses were dragged into the Uni-Mind, neighboring countries were impacted and China threatened to use nuclear weapons, the Eternals of Olympia intervened, entering in conflict with the Youngs Gods, while the Druig-sent Legba went on a talk with Varua. It is unknown if Varua's claims were true, though Makkari expressed doubt and Legba hinted it wasn't. panhuman uni mind.bio: ===Origin=== After being taken by the Celestials during the Fourth Host, the Young Gods traveled with them, with no instructions, directions or even attention. After having tried to communicate, even battled them, the Young Gods eventually fell into some form of madness, but eventually realized that the Celestials wanted them to act on their own. Varua eventually had the insight that the Celestials were in fact Uni-Minds from entire planets, encased into armor. ===Creation=== They returned to Earth and created a giant armor in Madripoor, then Varua formed the Panhuman Uni-Mind, intending to put it in the armor, bringing the Celestial Terran to life, for him to take his place into the Fifth Host, and for humanity to unite and be taken to the next level. panic.name: Panic
panic.origin: Panic was a member of the Freelancers, a group of super-powered enforcers who were hired by Roxxon to shut down the protesters at the Angeles National Forest that opposed the company's intention to build a pipeline that connected their West Coast headquarters to a new deep-water drilling platform off the coast. Might had Panic use her powers on reporter Ximena Xingtao to get her to leave the scene. When the Champions arrived to the scene to stop them, Panic used her abilities on the protesters, causing them to fight each other. Cyclops tried to stop her and convince her to find a peaceful way to resolve the situation, but she put him in a state of panic as well. She then tried to user her powers on Viv, but she headbutted Panic and knocked her down. As she was still unconscious, Viv placed Panic on the bus she used to evacuate the protesters from the area when a monster originating from the Leviathon Tide landed on the forest and threatened to burn it down. The Freelancers were later hired for other jobs, including disrupting a wage protest in Durham, North Carolina and displacing homeless people from a tent city in Los Angeles, California. The Freelancers invited two of the homeless people they displaced to their compound, and manipulated them into fighting each other, later using Panic's powers to have them tell the authorities that the Champions had assaulted them.
